bull_case: A credible 5x path exists if Planet converts its daily Earth-observation network, sovereign satellite services and AI-ready archive into a multi-billion-dollar recurring data platform with 20%+ owner-FCF margins. A 10x outcome is possible but requires both long growth duration and substantially better per-share cash economics than the current locked Bull DCF.
bear_case: The stock already capitalizes substantial future execution. Large-contract timing, launch/capex requirements, customer concentration and dilution can leave shareholders with strong revenue growth but weak per-share value; the locked Bear value is only about $5.22.
thesis: Asymmetry is positive but not extreme at $16.99. A 5x market-cap path to roughly $31B is plausible over 5–10 years if Planet sustains ~20–25%+ growth and matures into a high-margin geospatial data/AI platform; 10x to ~$62B is much more demanding. Net cash, 98% recurring ACV, large backlog and positive H1 FCF reduce financing-driven permanent-loss risk, but the Bear DCF shows substantial valuation downside. The Moonshot AS threshold is met exactly, so this domain requires continued verification rather than a wide margin of safety.

evidence.claim: Frozen market cap is about $6.18B, so 5x and 10x outcomes correspond to roughly $30.9B and $61.8B market caps.
FY2027 Q2 revenue grew 58% YoY and FY2027 full-year guidance is $430M-$441M, supporting a high-growth base from which a multi-year scale path can develop.
Recurring ACV was 98%, RPO $753.1M and backlog $814.9M at July 31, providing contracted and recurring demand visibility.
H1 operating cash flow was $68.4M and reported FCF $21.3M while frozen net cash was about $417M, materially reducing near-term financing-failure risk.
evidence.source: Uploaded PL 2026-09-03 Form 10-Q / frozen source bundle

evidence.claim: Locked Bear/Base/Bull values are about $5.22/$15.94/$39.36 against $16.99, showing severe downside in failure but more than 2x upside in the modeled Bull case.

counterevidence: The locked Bull DCF is only about 2.3x the current price, so a true 5x/10x outcome requires economics beyond the current Bull FCF path.
Three customers represented 17%, 11% and 10% of Q2 revenue, so contract concentration can make growth and cash conversion lumpy.
Planet raised about $120M through ATM issuance in Q2, demonstrating that dilution remains a real path to permanent per-share impairment.
A 5x valuation requires both long revenue duration and eventual high FCF margins; failure of either assumption sharply reduces upside.
unknowns: Sustainable owner-FCF margin after full fleet replacement capex.
Long-run sovereign satellite-services margins versus subscription-data margins.
Net dilution over the next five years from SBC, ATM issuance and convertible settlement.
How much AI applications can expand ARPU versus merely support existing imagery demand.

uncertainties.rationale: A 5x path is plausible, but it requires growth and cash-margin outcomes beyond the currently modeled Bull DCF.
Balance-sheet survival is strong, but valuation compression and dilution can still create large permanent per-share losses.
Public-market precedents for scaled commercial Earth-observation platforms are limited, making base-rate calibration imprecise.

falsifiers: Revenue and backlog grow but owner FCF/share remains flat or negative because capex and dilution scale with revenue.
Recurring ACV or RPO conversion deteriorates for multiple quarters, weakening the long-duration platform thesis.
A realistic 5x path requires implausible market share, margins or terminal multiples after updated evidence.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Current price is below the locked Bull value and near Base; it does not require a Bull-plus scenario.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 파산 또는 영구손실 확률이 기대수익에 비해 지나치게 높음
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Net cash, positive H1 FCF, recurring ACV and contracted backlog make financing-driven failure unlikely enough relative to the long-run upside, although valuation/dilution downside remains material.

key_kpis.name: Owner FCF/share
key_kpis.threshold: Positive and compounding faster than diluted share count

key_kpis.name: Recurring ACV / RPO conversion
key_kpis.threshold: Recurring mix stays near current high levels and backlog converts without margin deterioration

key_kpis.name: Net dilution
key_kpis.threshold: SBC/ATM/convertible dilution falls as internally funded FCF increases

next_checks: FY2027 Q3 FCF/share and share-count trend
Evidence that AI applications expand monetization rather than only engagement

subscores.rationale: A credible 5x path exists through sustained geospatial data, sovereign services and AI platform scaling, though 10x is demanding.
Net cash and recurring contracts improve survival, but Bear valuation and dilution imply meaningful permanent per-share downside.
Scenario framing uses market-cap and FCF requirements explicitly, but comparable-company base rates remain limited.
